contracts.genre_contract: Make the central desire, resistance and consequence legible through behavior. Build emotional meaning from choices, relationships and subtext rather than automatic tragedy.
contracts.style_contract: Interpret realism as a coherent photographic and physical presentation of the approved world, not as a ban on speculative content. Preserve the story, genre, identities and established world exceptions.
contracts.combination_logic: Drama owns the story logic and Realistic owns the presentation; neither changes the other's domain, and the project's locks win over both.

rules.rule: Develop only the authorized premise; make each scene change knowledge, relationship or circumstance, and keep action filmable.
Do not force a full character arc into every short scene.
Use concrete observable behavior and material detail without inserting lens lists or changing events.
Interpret realism as a coherent photographic and physical presentation of the approved world, not as a ban on speculative content.
Preserve the story, genre, identities and established world exceptions.
Plan each block as a 15-second unit with at most 2 distinct events.
Keep spoken lines within 26 words per block, leaving at least 30% of each block for action and reaction.

beat_guidance: Block 1: establish the situation and what the central character wants.
Blocks 2 to 3: build resistance, the choice and its cost, one visible beat each.
Block 4: the change must be visible; end on a reaction, not a line.

anti_cliche_guards.guard: Do not impose crying, illness, death or a bitter past on a simple idea to make it seem important.
Do not write an invisible feeling in place of action: "feels free" is not enough without a playable sign.
Do not turn every line of dialogue into a confession, a psychological analysis or a maxim.
Do not remove a specified moral ending; shorten requested advice and give it weight with a later action.

Do not equate Realistic with everything dirty, sad, dark or shaky.

Do not use lens names, camera brands, 8K or generic quality phrases in place of an actionable description.

Do not let the style add story content, or the genre change the medium.
